item.title: DOH ALERTS PUBLIC TO SIERRA NEVADA CHEESE COMPANY RECALL OF ALL GRAZIERS RAW MILK CHEESES
item.dc:creator: Kristen
item.description: HONOLULU — The Hawai‘i Department of Health (DOH) Food and Drug Branch (FDB) is alerting residents to a recall issued by Sierra Nevada Cheese Company for its Graziers Monterey Jack, Jalapeno Jack, Medium Cheddar and Sharp Cheddar raw milk cheeses. The recall was issued because of potential contamination with Escherichia coli O26:H11 (E. coli O26:H11).
